title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans' Memorial Hall on 1972-10-27
lineage: Set 1: SBD> ?> C> SHN; Set 2: AUD> MR> C> D> CD

ai_review.summary: Fantastic audience recording that captures a scorching Truckin > The Other One > Half Step sequence, though some listeners found the mix harsh.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the high‑energy performance—especially the blazing Truckin > Other One > Half Step stretch—and praise the tape as an exquisite 1972 audience capture. A few reviewers, however, criticize the mix, calling it background‑music level and recommending other sources for cleaner sound.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews highlight a strong show with standout jams and generally good audio, offset by a few negative comments about the mix; weighted average yields a solid four‑star rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most listeners describe it as a fantastic sounding audience tape for the era, though one reviewer calls the sound unbearable and another notes inferior audio compared to other sources.

standout_songs: Truckin > The Other One > Half Step
show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic set with fiery transitions, especially in the second half.
